title: Just Whitelist
description: Just a whitelist plugin that adds a whitelist by name, IP, and UUID
body:
# JustWhitelist

## Why you should download this whitelist
The whitelist supports username, IP, and UUID  
Extremely lightweight, no measurable performance impact   
It's very easy to use  
Supports hex and &0-9 &a-f etc  
It's highly customizable  

## Commands

`/jwl enable` - Enables whitelist   
`/jwl disable` - Disables whitelist   
`/jwl list` - Shows whitelist content   
`/jwl add <name>` - Adds player name to whitelist   
`/jwl addip <ip>` - Adds IP to whitelist   
`/jwl adduuid <uuid>` - Adds UUID to whitelist   
`/jwl remove <name>` - Removes player name from whitelist   
`/jwl removeip <ip>` - Removes IP from whitelist   
`/jwl removeuuid <uuid>` - Removes UUID from whitelist   
`/jwl reload` - Reloads config
